# Get Queue Status

![Get Queue Status function icon](../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/synchronization/queue/04_Get%20queue%20status.svg)

[Synchronization functions](../index.md) · [All functions](../../index.md)

Reads a coherent instant snapshot: name, capacity, count and waiting operations. Preview and dequeue both count as pending removals. Elements are returned only when requested, without removal; otherwise that output is an empty array. Queue&lt;T&gt; is an execution resource reference; element is the ordinary T value. Public FROG target compilation remains unavailable.

## Studio authoring profile

Contract status: **partial**. The connector below describes Studio authoring; execution availability is stated separately.

Reads a coherent instant snapshot: name, capacity, count and waiting operations. Preview and dequeue both count as pending removals. Elements are returned only when requested, without removal; otherwise that output is an empty array.

## Queue behavior

Returns one coherent instant snapshot of the name, capacity, element count and waiting operations. Both Preview and Dequeue count as pending removals. With return elements? false, elements is an empty outer array; true returns the current messages without removing them.

Queue&lt;T&gt; is a nominal execution-resource access reference. The complete T schema is invariant; an Array, Cluster or Enum message remains one T value. Collection outputs add one outer rank-1 Array.
